before.name: Joka Heshima Jinsai
before.description: Joka Heshima Jinsai, legally Shannon Lemar Denham, is an incarcerated writer and community organizer associated with the Autonomous Infrastructure Mission and the campaign to end the Thirteenth Amendment’s punishment exception. His supporters describe work on community food, education and economic initiatives. He has challenged prolonged segregation linked to political expression. CDCR listed him at Kern Valley State Prison on September 10, 2026. The case below concerns that prison segregation rather than classifying his original criminal prosecution as activism-related custody.
